propertySets.name: Pset_Risk
propertySets.definition: An indication of exposure to mischance, peril, menace, hazard or loss. Documentation of a potential hazard, likilihood and consequence aligned with AS/NZS 4360 and BS PAS 1192-6:2017, which can be assigned to or associated with a product, activity and/or location. Alternatively it may be assigned to an ISO 3864 annotation symbol.HISTORY Extended in IFC2x3, Revised IFC4x3There are various types of risk that may be encountered and there may be several instances of Pset_Risk associated to an instance or type.

properties.name: RiskName
properties.definition: A locally unique identifier for the risk entry that can be used to track the development and mitigation of the risk throughout the project life cycle

properties.name: RiskType
properties.definition: Identifies the predefined types of risk from which the type required may be set.

properties.name: NatureOfRisk
properties.definition: A description of the generic nature of the context or hazard that might be encountered.

properties.name: RiskAssessmentMethodology
properties.definition: An indication or link to the chosen risk assessment methodology, for example PAS1192-6 or a chosen ISO13100 annex.

properties.name: UnmitigatedRiskLikelihood
properties.definition: Identifies the likelihood of the hazard prior to any specific mitigation.

properties.name: UnmitigatedRiskConsequence
properties.definition: Identifies the consequence of the hazard prior to any specific mitigation.

properties.name: UnmitigatedRiskSignificance
properties.definition: Identifies the significance of the risk given the likelihood and consequence prior to any specific mitigation.

properties.name: MitigationPlanned
properties.definition: The planned (agreed and irrevocable) mitigation of the likelhood and consequences of the hazard.

properties.name: MitigatedRiskLikelihood
properties.definition: Identifies the likelihood of the hazard given the planned mitigation.

properties.name: MitigatedRiskConsequence
properties.definition: Identifies the consequence of the hazard given the planned mitigation.

properties.name: MitigatedRiskSignificance
properties.definition: Identifies the significance of the risk given the mitigation of likelihood and consequence.

properties.name: MitigationProposed
properties.definition: Any proposed, but not yet agreed and irrevocable, mitigation of the likelhood and consequences of the hazard.

properties.name: AssociatedProduct
properties.definition: An indication or link to any associated product or material that may trigger the hazard. If used directly on an annotation or semantic object. for an alternative see group use encoding template

properties.name: AssociatedActivity
properties.definition: An indication or link to any associated activity or process that may trigger the hazard. If used directly on an annotation or semantic object. for an alternative see group use encoding template

properties.name: AssociatedLocation
properties.definition: An indication or link to any associated location or space that may trigger the hazard. If used directly on an annotation or semantic object. for an alternative see group use encoding template

propertySets.name: Pset_Tolerance
propertySets.definition: Properties expressing the tolerance relating to locating and shaping of an intended element or feature. Range diameters are non-negative describing a linear, rectangular or  boxed region  .

properties.name: ToleranceDescription
properties.definition: General description of the tolerance associated to the element or feature, its source and implications.

properties.name: ToleranceBasis
properties.definition: Indication of the basis of the tolerance requirement

properties.name: OverallTolerance
properties.definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range tolerance associated to the intended shape and position in XYZ.

properties.name: HorizontalTolerance
properties.definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range tolerance associated to the horizontal shape and position in X, if different to the overall tolerance.

properties.name: OrthogonalTolerance
properties.definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range tolerance associated to the horizontal shape and position in Y, if different to the overall tolerance.

properties.name: VerticalTolerance
properties.definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range tolerance associated to the vertical shape and position in Z, if different to the overall tolerance.

properties.name: PlanarFlatness
properties.definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range flatness associated to the intended shape and position in XYZ.

properties.name: HorizontalFlatness
properties.definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range flatness associated to the horizontal surface in XY, if different to the overall flatness.

properties.name: ElevationalFlatness
properties.definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range flatness associated to the elevational surface in ZX, if different to the overall flatness.

properties.name: SideFlatness
properties.definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range flatness associated to the side surface in YZ, if different to the overall flatness.

properties.name: OverallOrthogonality
properties.definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range orthogonality associated to the intended shape and orientation in XYZ.

properties.name: HorizontalOrthogonality
properties.definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range orthogonality associated to the horizontal shape and orientation in X, if different to the overall orthogonality.

properties.name: OrthogonalOrthogonality
properties.definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range orthogonality associated to the horizontal shape and orientation in Y, if different to the overall orthogonality.

properties.name: VerticalOrthogonality
properties.definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range orthogonality associated to the vertical shape and orientation in Z, if different to the overall orthogonality.

properties.name: OverallStraightness
properties.definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range straightness associated to the intended shape.

properties.name: HorizontalStraightness
properties.definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range straightness  associated to the horizontal shape in X, if different to the overall straightness.

properties.name: OrthogonalStraightness
properties.definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range straightness  associated to the horizontal shape  in Y, if different to the overall straightness.

properties.name: VerticalStraightness
properties.definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range straightness associated to the vertical shape in Z, if different to the overall straightness.

propertySets.name: Pset_Uncertainty
propertySets.definition: Property set capturing the geometric uncertainty regarding measurements including how the way that uncertainty was assessed.

properties.name: UncertaintyBasis
properties.definition: Indication of the basis of the uncertainty

properties.name: UncertaintyDescription
properties.definition: General description of the uncertainty associated to the element or feature, its source and implications.

properties.name: HorizontalUncertainty
properties.definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range diameter associated to the vertical shape and position in X, if different to the linear uncertainty.

properties.name: LinearUncertainty
properties.definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range diameter associated to the overall shape and position in XYZ.

properties.name: OrthogonalUncertainty
properties.definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range diameter associated to the horizontal shape and position in Y, if different to the horizontal uncertainty.

properties.name: VerticalUncertainty
properties.definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range diameter associated to the vertical shape and position in Z, if different to the linear uncertainty.

propertySets.name: Qto_BodyGeometryValidation
propertySets.definition: Quantities supplied for validating the correct interpretation of the body shape representation at import. In case of multiple representation items, the quantities are summed for each of the items (irrespective of any overlap). Choosing a suitable tolerance value for comparing the supplied numbers to the numbers calculated from the reconstructed geometry is at the discretion of the importing application.
